verdict.rationale: Smithery runs its own searchable registry of MCP servers. Developers can reach these servers through its connect layer, and Smithery maintains OAuth apps for popular integrations, with Exa, Context7 and Browserbase named as examples. An independent scan of the registry's 'top 100 servers' implies the catalog holds at least that many, but no source documents hundreds-to-thousands of integrations. missing for 10: documented catalog size in the hundreds or thousands, evidence of breadth across third-party app and API categories, independent corroboration of catalog depth.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reach a deep catalog of third-party apps and APIs (hundreds to thousands of integrations) through the platform
